settings.name: CHECK_MINUTES
settings.label: Minutes between checks
settings.hint: How often the servers are compared with the master list on their own; 0: only when someone looks.

settings.name: BACKGROUND
settings.label: Compare the servers and keep dynamic DNS current in the background
settings.hint: Off: nothing is compared and no address is updated until someone asks from the pages.

settings.name: DDNS_DETECT
settings.label: How the public address is found
settings.hint: auto (a few public services), unifi:<server id> (a UniFi gateway), or the address of a page that answers with the IP.

settings.name: DDNS_MINUTES
settings.label: Minutes between address checks
settings.hint: How often the public address is looked up for the records that follow it; 0: only when someone asks.
